mapper.select: select Cpd_Id from Project_Cp_Dtl where Cp_Id=#{cpId} and Cpd_Person_Id is null
select Cpd_Id from Project_Cp_Dtl where Cp_Id=#{cpId} and Cpd_Create_Uid is null

select cpl.Cpl_Sort as cpdSort, cpl.Cpl_Parent_Id as cpdParentId, cpl.Cpl_Administration_Url as cpdAdministrationUrl, cpl.Cpl_Administration_Url_H as cpdAdministrationUrlH, cpl.Cpl_File_Expiain as cplFileExpiain, cpl.Cpl_Achievement_Type as cplAchievementType, cpl.T_Code as tCode, (select count(*) from Project_Cp_Dtl_Cancel cdc where cdc.cpd_id=wn.cpd_id and cdc.state!=3 and cdc.state!=7) approveCpCancel, wn.* from Project_Cp_Dtl wn left join Project_Cp_Library cpl on cpl.Cpl_Id = wn.Cpd_Cpl_Id where wn.Cp_Id = #{cpId} order by cpl.Cpl_Sort asc
select distinct mn.Cpd_Cpl_Id from Project_Cp_Dtl mn left join Project_Cp cp on cp.Cp_Id = mn.Cp_Id where cp.P_Id = #{pId}

select cpl.Cpl_Sort as cpdSort, cpl.Cpl_Parent_Id as cpdParentId, cpl.Cpl_Administration_Url as cpdAdministrationUrl, cpl.Cpl_Administration_Url_H as cpdAdministrationUrlH, dtl.* from Project_Cp_Dtl dtl left join Project_Cp cp on cp.Cp_Id = dtl.Cp_Id left join Project_Cp_Library cpl on cpl.Cpl_Id = dtl.Cpd_Cpl_Id where cp.P_Id = #{pId} order by dtl.Cpd_Sort asc

select pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, cpl.Cpl_Sort as cpdSort, cpl.Cpl_Parent_Id as cpdParentId, cpl.Cpl_Administration_Url as cpdAdministrationUrl, cpl.Cpl_Administration_Url_H as cpdAdministrationUrlH, cpl.Cpl_Achievement_Type as cplAchievementType, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, dtl.* from Project_Cp_Dtl dtl left join Project_Cp cp on cp.Cp_Id = dtl.Cp_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = cp.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join Project_Cp_Library cpl on cpl.Cpl_Id = dtl.Cpd_Cpl_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileId = dtl.Cpd_Id where dtl.Cpd_Id = #{cpdId}

select pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, cpl.Cpl_Sort as cpdSort, cpl.Cpl_Parent_Id as cpdParentId, cpl.Cpl_Administration_Url as cpdAdministrationUrl, cpl.Cpl_Administration_Url_H as cpdAdministrationUrlH, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, dtl.* from Project_Cp_Dtl dtl left join Project_Cp cp on cp.Cp_Id=dtl.Cp_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=cp.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Project_Cp_Library cpl on cpl.Cpl_Id=dtl.Cpd_Cpl_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileId=dtl.Cpd_Id where dtl.Cp_Id in
#{cpId}

SELECT pp.p_id pId, pp.p_name PName, cpd.cpd_code CpdCode, cpd.cpd_name CpdName FROM Project_Cp cp LEFT JOIN Project_Cp_Dtl cpd ON cp.cp_id = cpd.cp_id LEFT JOIN Pre_Project pp ON cp.p_id = pp.p_id WHERE cpd.cpd_state != 0 AND cpd.cpd_state != 3 AND cpd.cpd_code IN
#{code}

select f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.id as pcrId, mn.Pcr_Doc as pcrDoc, pp.P_Name as pName, pcd.Cpd_Name as cpdName, mn.file_name as fileName, mn.file_approval_time as fileApprovalTime, sd1.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, sd2.D_Name as pDepartmentName, pp.P_Build_Model as pBuildModel, mn.Create_Uname, mn.Create_Time, pp.P_Category as pCategory, mn.file_Expire as fileExpire, mn.file_expiration_date as fileExpirationDate from Project_Cp_Rpr mn left join Project_Cp_Dtl pcd on mn.Cpd_Id = pcd.Cpd_Id left join Project_Cp pc on pc.Cp_Id = pcd.Cp_Id left join Pre_Project pp on pp.P_Id = pc.P_Id left join sys_department sd1 on sd1.D_Id = pp.p_Competent_Department left join sys_department sd2 on sd2.D_Id = pp.P_Department left join Sys_File f on f.fileid=mn.id
${request.authSql}
where 1 = 1
and mn.operation_Type !='cancel'
and pp.P_Category=#{request.pCategory}
and mn.Cpd_Id=#{request.cpdId}
and pcd.Cpd_Cpl_Id in
#{id}
and 1=0
and INSTR(pp.P_Name,#{request.pName})
and INSTR(sd2.D_Name,#{request.pDepartmentName})
and INSTR(sd1.D_Name,#{request.pCompetentDepartmentName})
and INSTR(pcd.Cpd_Name,#{request.cpdName})
and INSTR(mn.file_name,#{request.fileName})
and pp.P_Build_Model=#{request.pBuildModel}
and INSTR(mn.Create_Uname,#{request.createUname})
and DATE_FORMAT(mn.file_approval_time, '%Y-%m-%d') like concat('%',#{request.fileApprovalTime},'%')
and DATE_FORMAT(mn.file_expiration_date, '%Y-%m-%d') like concat('%',#{request.fileExpirationDate},'%')
and DATE_FORMAT(mn.Create_Time, '%Y-%m-%d') like concat('%',#{request.createTime},'%')
select mn.* from gant_section mn left join Gantt_Plan gp on gp.Plan_Id = mn.Plan_Id where gp.Plan_State = 7 and gp.P_Id = #{pId}
